get_TCFG_tokenizer_class: get the TCFG tokenizer class for a given model name or HuggingFace tokenizer instance
TCFG_Tokenizer_from_hf_tokenizer: create a TCFG tokenizer wrapper from a HuggingFace tokenizer auto-selecting the right subclass
TCFG_Tokenizer_get_tokens_as_bytes: get all tokens in the vocabulary as a list of bytes objects
TCFG_LlamaTokenizer_format_token_as_byte: format a Llama token ID as bytes by converting hex escape sequences to raw bytes
TCFG_GPT2Tokenizer_format_token_as_bytes: format a GPT-2 token ID as bytes by decoding it and skipping special tokens
